content:
Overview

Scottsdale is a city in AZ with a population of 243,050. Desert luxury with golf resorts, spas, art galleries, and premium Arizona living. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 299 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 49.2.
